operator_config.name: defaultMaxModels
operator_config.doc:
defaultMaxModels is the default limit for models fetched PER PATTERN.
This limit is applied independently to each pattern in includedModels
(e.g., "ibm-granite/*", "meta-llama/*") to prevent overloading the
Hugging Face API with too many requests and to respect rate limiting.

Example: with maxModels=100 and 3 patterns, up to 300 models total may be fetched.
Set to 0 to disable the limit (not recommended for large organizations).

operator_config.name: defaultSyncInterval
operator_config.doc:
defaultSyncInterval is the default interval for periodic syncing of models.
This can be overridden via the syncInterval property in the source configuration.
For testing, a shorter interval (e.g., "1s" or "10s") can be used to speed up tests.

summary: model-registry is a Kubernetes component. deploying 3 workload(s) (model-catalog-server, minio, controller-manager) with 3 container(s). watching 1 resource type(s). exposing 1 service(s) on ports: 8080. Dockerfile EXPOSE ports: 8080. connecting to external services: aiohttp, requests, s3, urllib. runtime dependencies: MinIO/S3, MySQL, PostgreSQL, S3. with 705 operator config constants (1 image references, 60 env vars). Python k8s client with 54 API call(s). integrates with Istio, management relationship via labels/annotations. references components: kserve (import), kubeflow (import). mounts 2 ConfigMap(s) as volumes: mcp-catalog-sources, model-catalog-sources.
